title: How They Met
caption: Every great love story has a beginning — a moment where two people, each living their own life, find themselves in the same place at the same time. This was Ankit and Avani's beginning.

title: First Memories
caption: The early days of something beautiful — conversations that felt easy, silences that felt comfortable, and the quiet realization that this person was someone special.

title: Special Moments
caption: Love isn't just the grand gestures — it lives in the small, quiet moments. The shared laughter, the inside jokes, the memories that only they understand.

title: Their Journey Together
caption: Two lives slowly becoming one — sharing dreams, supporting each other through every season, and building something beautiful that belongs only to them.

title: The Engagement
caption: A ring, a question, and a promise that would shape the rest of their lives. The moment two hearts decided that forever was exactly the right amount of time.

title: A Beautiful New Beginning
caption: And now, on the most beautiful day, Ankit and Avani walk toward the rest of their lives — hand in hand, heart in heart, ready for everything that forever holds.
